Callout.Name: Animal on the Carriageway
Callout.Message: Cow on the carriageway, drivers stopping.

Script.Line: It is on the carriageway and the traffic is doing seventy at it.
Two cars have already gone onto the hard shoulder to miss it.
I am not going out there on foot. Not for that.

Lines.Approach: There is a cow on the carriageway and drivers are stopping to film it. Clear the traffic first.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
